title: accounts.yaml::symbols is a DATA-PULL list, not a gate — the roster is the single source for what trades, and a stale pull list is a pull-list bug, never a trading decision
note:
OPERATOR-RAISED 2026-09-22, verbatim: 'In general, I don't get why uh, th there shouldn't be a symbol specific list for each account. That's what the strategy roster is for. It trades whatever the strategies that it's trading are trading... That's exactly the kind of double gate that just stops things from working for no reason that is completely unnecessary to anything that we're doing here.' [!] VERIFIED, AND THE OPERATOR IS RIGHT ON BOTH HALVES — it is a gate, and it is redundant. IT IS A GATE, established in code and not inferred: src/main.py:714 `_resolve_tick_symbols` builds the set of symbols the trader FETCHES CANDLES FOR from each account's `symbols:` list, NOT from its roster. A symbol absent there means no data, no signal, no order — the leg sits on the roster looking wired and trades nothing. Two other readers exist and neither is a gate: src/runtime/intents.py::supported_symbols() unions the declared symbols with a static base as a VALIDATION whitelist and fails SAFE (a config-load failure falls back to the base, never narrower), and intent_multiplexer.py:485 reads the per-STRATEGY symbols, a different field. ⚠️ intents.py:100 contradicts itself inside one sentence — 'This is a validation whitelist, not a runtime on/off gate — accounts.yaml `symbols` drives what actually trades.' Field beats comment, and here the field is main.py:714. IT IS REDUNDANT, MEASURED over all 11 accounts by parsing config/accounts.yaml and config/strategies.yaml 2026-09-22: 19 ORPHAN symbols declared that no rostered leg needs (alpaca_live 8, alpaca_portfolio 7, bybit_2 1, bybit_portfolio 1, ib_live 1, oanda_practice 1), and 0 MISSING. ⚠️ READ THE ZERO CORRECTLY — IT IS NOT REASSURANCE, IT IS THE NEAR-MISS. It reads 0 only because the R8 promotion checked symbol coverage BEFORE the edit: avax_pullback_2h was about to join bybit_2 (REAL MONEY) while AVAXUSDT was absent from its list. Caught by looking, not by any guard — nothing in CI asserts the relationship, so the next one is caught by noticing silence, which is exactly how this class of defect is normally found: late. [!] AND THE FIX IS ALREADY HALF-WRITTEN IN THE SAME FILE: src/main.py:267 `_symbols_for_account` ALREADY derives the union of an account's roster symbols — it simply is not what _resolve_tick_symbols consults. [!] PROPOSED (Tier-2, additive, cannot narrow): _resolve_tick_symbols unions the roster-implied symbols into the declared ones, so the ROSTER is the single source and `symbols:` degrades to an additive override for anything a roster cannot imply. Nothing that trades today stops trading — the change can only ADD symbols to the fetch set. Plus a CI check that a rostered leg's symbol is always reachable, so the AVAXUSDT case fails a build instead of failing quietly. [!] THIS IS NOT THE 'no third gate' RULE BEING RESTATED — IT IS AN INSTANCE OF IT. CLAUDE.md § 'The two execution gates' says 'never hide a capability behind a default-off flag (the pattern that stranded MES)'. A symbol list that must be edited in a second place to let a rostered leg trade is that pattern wearing different clothes, and it stranded a leg today. [!] OPERATOR REFRAMED IT 2026-09-22 AND THE REFRAME IS SHARPER THAN THIS ROW WAS, verbatim: 'There are two separate issues here. There's the issue of what trades on what account and what data gets pulled from the account, and those are two separate things that aren't dependent. Obviously anything that's trading will need to be pulling the data, but we can still continue pulling data... for other things even if they're not being traded. But that shouldn't be formatted as a gate. That should just be formatted as additional data pulls unrelated to the strategies themselves. So we do need to find a way to union that so that we're not doing double declarations. But it also needs to make sure that the data-pull roster is not going to interfere with the strategy roster. And even if something is for some reason missing from the pull list, it doesn't mean that it shouldn't be traded — it means that the pull list is not updated correctly.' [!] SO THE SPEC IS FOUR PROPERTIES, not 'remove the second list': (1) the STRATEGY ROSTER decides what trades, full stop; (2) `symbols:` becomes a pure ADDITIVE data-pull list and it is LEGITIMATE for it to carry symbols nothing trades; (3) fetch set = UNION(roster-implied, declared), so no double declaration; (4) a symbol missing from the pull list is a PULL-LIST BUG, never a reason a rostered leg does not trade — and the CI check's FAILURE MESSAGE must say that, in those terms. [!] THIS CHANGES THE DISPOSITION OF THE 19 ORPHANS: under the reframe they are LEGITIMATE data pulls, not drift to clean up. The lane is fenced off them. My earlier framing called them redundancy; that was the one-list reading and the operator's two-concern reading is better. Dispatched as a lane, Tier-2, landing hold.  ||| LANE REPORT 2026-09-22 (session_01PDnYMJCPBohXArAKpUceZm, Tier-2, HELD). REACHED: merged=NO, deployed=NO, observed=NO. STATE IS `blocked`, NOT `landed_unproven` -- close-out check 3 caught this row asserting `landed_unproven` while the PR was still open. Per the states vocabulary `landed_unproven` means MERGED with the effect unobserved; nothing of this lane is on main. It becomes `landed_unproven` on merge and `done` only on the observation named at the end of this note. Draft PR #12736 open (branch lane/e42-roster-symbol-union), landing hold, hold_reason tier_2_3_needs_approval. RE-VERIFIED RATHER THAN INHERITED (RULE ONE), all four dispatch claims: (a) src/main.py::_resolve_tick_symbols does build the fetch set from acct.symbols and never from the roster - CONFIRMED by reading the function; (b) _symbols_for_account already derives the roster union and had exactly one caller, _apply_per_account_leverage - CONFIRMED by grep (2 call sites, one a test); (c) routing does NOT consult symbols - CONFIRMED: coordinator._dispatch_exclusion_reason tests `pkg.strategy not in assigned` plus symbol->exchange, and the only other account-level `symbols` readers are data pulls (clients.py position cross-check, runtime/exchange_accounts.py fill sweep), which is the operator's framing already true in code; (d) THE ONE DISPATCH CLAIM THAT DID NOT SURVIVE: intents.py::supported_symbols() was described as 'NOT a gate - do not fix it'. It fails safe against a config-load FAILURE, but for a symbol declared on NO account it is a hard refusal - StrategyIntent.__post_init__ RAISES ValueError. It was merely UNREACHABLE, because nothing fetched such a symbol. Widening the fetch set is exactly what makes it reachable, so widening only main.py would have converted a silent no-trade into a ValueError on the live tick path. Both are widened, in the same PR, with a negative control asserting a typo is still refused. PROPERTY PROVEN, NOT ASSERTED: MEASURED over config/accounts.yaml x config/strategies.yaml at 06914ce2f (11 accounts, 9 rostering, 55 strategies) the global fetch set is 23 symbols BEFORE and the same 23 AFTER (0 added, 0 removed), and supported_symbols() is 24 before and 24 after. tests/test_roster_symbol_union.py::TestLiveConfigIsUnchangedByThisPR pins that over the checked-in config so a future edit breaks a test instead of a deploy. The 11 new tests carry their own negative control: with the union line removed, 2 of 11 fail on the exact defect (run, then restored). GUARD: scripts/ci/check_roster_symbol_reachability.py, registered in run_guards.py as `roster-symbol-reachability`, --self-test run before the tree check on every invocation. 10 controls: the planted 2026-09-22 positive (real-money account rostering avax_pullback_2h while AVAXUSDT is absent from its pull list) goes red; a correct pull list, an orphan-carrying pull list, an empty roster, and an unreadable instruments.yaml all stay green. Its failure message names the PULL LIST and says in terms that the leg trades regardless and that a roster must not be touched to satisfy it. Green on the tree: 0 unreachable. FIELD NOT RENAMED, and the choice was ESTABLISHED not guessed: bot_config.py::_ACCOUNT_PUBLIC_FIELDS publishes `symbols` on /api/bot/config and its own comment says the SPA derives its symbol selectors from it, so a rename breaks a consumer in another repo. Documented instead, in the most-read place (a header block in accounts.yaml) plus 7 other prose surfaces. ORPHAN COUNT CORRECTED FOR ITS POPULATION: this row says 19; the guard reports 21 over every account not `enabled: false`, including ib_live/MES and oanda_practice/XAUUSD (explicit empty rosters) and BTCUSDT on bybit_2 + bybit_portfolio. Both are right about different sets; neither number means anything without the set, so the guard prints its denominators. THE AVAXUSDT NEAR-MISS IS REAL AND NOW HAS A LOCATOR: commit d257fe576 on claude/r8-wire-fold-consistent-legs - STAGED, NOT merged to main - adds avax_pullback_2h to bybit_2's real-money roster and AVAXUSDT to its `symbols:` in the same diff, with an inline comment saying the symbol 'was absent here'. SCOPE FENCE HELD AND SHOWN: config/accounts.yaml is comment-only - parsing both sides of the diff yields identical YAML. No roster, no mode:, no execution:, no orphan removed. DOC RECONCILIATION (this change makes standing prose false): Prime Directive rule 6 in docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md, root CLAUDE.md, intents.py's self-contradicting comment, bot_config.py, docs/reference/bot-api-reference.md, docs/claude/system-actions.md, docs/TRADE-PIPELINE.md, and three accounts.yaml blocks - one of which had already been corrected once in the OPPOSITE direction and is now dated on both. WHAT WOULD CLOSE THIS ROW (landed_unproven -> done): the operator approves and the change deploys, then /api/diag/ or the trader journal shows a tick fetching a symbol that is roster-implied. Today no such symbol exists (0 missing), so the honest closing observation is the NEXT roster promotion that adds a leg without a pull-list edit: it trades, and roster-symbol-reachability reports the pull list as stale. NOT DONE, DELIBERATELY: accounts with an explicit `strategies: []` (ib_live, oanda_practice) are still skipped entirely, so their 2 declared symbols are still not fetched. Under the operator's 'additive data pulls unrelated to the strategies' framing arguably they should be; changing it would ADD symbols to the live fetch set, which is a behaviour change this lane was not asked for. Filed for the operator rather than decided here.
